description: First launch guides the user through entering and validating a FRED API key, then stores it in the macOS Keychain.
steps: Launch the app without an API key
See onboarding instructions and the API key entry field
Test and save a valid API key
Transition into the main workspace
Confirm Settings reports the key as stored in the Keychain

description: Users can search FRED series, browse results with a real selection highlight, and open a series in the detail workspace.
steps: Enter a search term in the sidebar
Receive result rows with key series metadata
Select a result and see it highlighted
See the detail dashboard load for that series
Confirm a failed lookup reports an error instead of doing nothing

description: Entering an exact FRED series ID surfaces that series first, even when popularity ranking would bury it.
steps: Type a series ID such as GDPC1 into the search field
Confirm the exact match appears at the top of the results
Confirm a prose query is unaffected

description: Favorites, recent searches, and the API key persist locally between app sessions.
steps: Favorite a series
Run at least one search
Reopen the app
Confirm favorites, recent searches, and the saved key are still present

description: Series detail shows charting, a sortable data table, and calculated statistics that are correct and clearly labelled.
steps: Open a series detail view
Inspect the metric tiles and insight cards
Switch between the Overview, Data, and Insights tabs
Sort the data table by date, value, and change
Confirm undefined metrics report n/a rather than a placeholder number

description: Level, Change, % Change, YoY %, and Index transforms are computed correctly and relabel the displayed units.
steps: Open a series and switch between all five transforms
Confirm growth transforms use history from before the visible window
Confirm year-over-year matches the observation closest to one year earlier
Confirm the index transform rebases to the first visible observation

description: Date windows are anchored to each series' own latest observation and are applied locally without refetching.
steps: Open a discontinued series and select a one-year window
Confirm the chart is populated rather than empty
Switch windows repeatedly
Confirm no additional network requests are issued

description: Charts shade U.S. recession periods using the NBER-based indicator, matching FRED's own charts, and the preference persists.
steps: Open a series that spans a recession
Confirm the recession months are shaded behind the plotted lines
Turn the Recessions checkbox off and confirm the bands disappear
Reopen the app and confirm the preference was remembered
Confirm a series load still succeeds when the indicator is unavailable

description: Users can compare multiple series, with sane handling when units differ, plus a correlation summary.
steps: Open a primary series
Add a comparison series with compatible units and confirm a shared axis
Add a comparison series with incompatible units and confirm the chart switches to an index comparison
Read the correlation summary
Remove a comparison series cleanly

description: Spread mode charts the primary series minus each comparison series, moving statistics, the data table, and exports with it.
steps: Open a rate series and add a second rate series
Switch the chart mode to Spread (A - B)
Confirm the chart plots the difference and the units read percentage points
Confirm the statistics, data table, and export all describe the spread
Confirm the mode is unavailable for series with incompatible units
Remove the comparison series and confirm the chart falls back to Overlay

description: Users can export exactly what they see to CSV/JSON and copy it to the clipboard, with success and failure both reported.
steps: Open a populated series
Export data as CSV and as JSON
Copy the visible dataset to the clipboard
Confirm the export contains every visible series, the window, and the transform
Confirm a cancelled or failed save is reported honestly

description: Data menu commands act on the open series and are disabled when no series is open.
steps: Open the Data menu with no series selected and confirm the commands are greyed out
Open a series
Use Refresh, Export as CSV, Export as JSON, and Copy Visible Data

description: Failures degrade gracefully: one bad comparison series does not blank the chart, and transient errors are retried.
steps: Add a comparison series that fails to load
Confirm the primary series still charts and a warning names the failing series
Confirm a failing primary series shows a retryable error state

description: Settings and README explain setup, storage, capabilities, and operational limits accurately.
steps: Open Settings
Confirm key storage location, workspace data counts, and cache controls are shown
Read the README
Confirm the documentation matches the shipped behaviour

description: The project builds warning-free under the Swift 6 language mode and the unit test suite runs cleanly from the command line.
steps: Run ./init.sh
Confirm the build reports no errors or warnings
Confirm every unit test passes
